body:
Thanks for looking into this issue!

Could you also check the remaining application-owned commands after IME commit?

- Tab / Shift+Tab
- Escape
- Up / Down
- Home / End / Page Up / Page Down
- Shift+arrow selection
- Option+arrow word navigation, including Shift+Option+arrow selection

Also, please deliver the original key event after the IME commits the text only when the IME returns an application-owned command through `doCommandBySelector:`, preserving the key’s modifiers, physical identity, and repeat state. Do not deliver an extra key event when the IME consumes it for candidate confirmation (selecting an entry from the list shown for Korean Hanja, Japanese Kanji, etc.)
